answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 18778 Country: India Title: if somebody is in journey and becoming imam for offering namaz(zohar) then after he completed two rakat namaz and he ended namaz by offering salaam . Is it Valid? Question: if somebody is in journey and becoming imam for offering namaz(zohar) then after he completed two rakat namaz and he ended namaz by offering salaam . Is it Valid? Answer ID: 18778 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 68/68=B=1431) Yes, it is alright. According to Hanafi Fiqh, a musafir must observe qasr salah. After performing two rak?ah, the musafir imam should say that he is musafir so the muqtadis should complete their salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
